card.name: Micrometre unit after a number
card.fires_on: The final piece of the micrometre unit (µm, μm, um, micron) right after a size number, such as a filter pore size or a thickness. It also fires weakly inside words starting with micro.

modes.label: Micrometre after a number
modes.description: The m or micron that completes µm after a measured size.
modes.example: Ensure that the administration set consists of a blood transfusion set equipped with a 200 µ<<m>> filter.

modes.label: Inside micro- words
modes.description: Partway through words that begin with micro, such as photomicrograph or micromolar.
